title:
POV: I ASKED A STRANGER IN ISRAEL FOR JUICE
WITH NO MONEY
beats: THE TEST: 'I'd like a juice - but actually I don't have money. Can you help me, please?'
'I'm really thirsty and I don't have any money.' - and he hands it over
'Really? Why did you help me?' 'Nothing.' 'Thank you so much.'
THE REVEAL: 'I'll be honest - I have money. I wanted to see how kind you are. This is for you.' 'No, no, no.'
AND WHO HE IS: 'I'm Jewish.' 'We are brothers.' 'Exactly. One God.' 'The world tries to divide - but in the end we are all the same. We live together.'
